caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object that resembles a decorative metal bracket or hook, rendered in black pencil on a plain light beige background. The main form consists of an elaborately curved arm with scrolling, leaf-like details and an eagle's head at the upper left, with its beak holding the end of a chain made of interlocking oval links that hangs downward. Below the eagle head, integrated into the bracket structure, there is a sculpted face resembling a lion or possibly a human, surrounded by further ornamental curves. The object has a symmetrical, baroque or Rococo design, emphasizing flowing lines and organic shapes. The overall coloration of the drawing is grayscale, achieved with precise shading to give the metallic elements a sense of depth and texture. The composition centers the object in the middle of the page, with ample negative space around it. Near the lower right of the object, there is a signature with the name "G.A. Townsend" and the year "1939."
title: Fragment of Fence
